description: v1.4.0 cumulative checkpoint. Includes v1.2.0 reliability rescue and v1.3.0 whole-video context. Adds low-latency safeguards: immediate foreground protocol rescue, 45-second look-ahead prefetch, delayed background context-card analysis, and an explicit build guard that keeps the normal 160-word / 1600-character / 30-second block ceilings and 6s/14s planning targets unchanged.
